name: Text to speech (Kokoro)
description: Reads your text aloud with a preset English voice: Kokoro-82M on the server's CPU, started when needed. No voice cloning.

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: Only the voices whose files are on this server. English only; no voice cloning.

timing_basis: one reviewed run on this server at default settings

name: Music (ACE-Step 1.5)
description: A song or an instrumental from style words and optional lyrics (ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo on the GPU).

tags.label: Style
tags.description: Genre, instruments, mood and tempo words, separated by commas.

lyrics.label: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Leave as [Instrumental] for no singing. Section tags like [verse] and [chorus] help.

duration.label: Length (seconds)
duration.description: The file is exactly this long (the workflow fills the length; measured 15 s asked, 15.02 s delivered).

timing_basis: one reviewed run on this server at default settings

name: Remove background (BiRefNet)
description: Cuts the subject out of a picture: a transparent PNG and the mask that was used.
timing_basis: one reviewed run on this server at default settings

name: Split into layers (Qwen-Image Layered)
description: Separates a picture into several transparent layers you can rearrange. Slow and memory hungry (about 50 GB; about 2 minutes measured).

prompt.label: Describe the picture
prompt.description: A short description of what is in the picture helps the model separate it.

timing_basis: one reviewed run on this server at default settings

name: Style from a picture (Krea 2)
description: Makes a new picture of what you describe, in the look of a reference picture (Krea 2 Turbo with its style-reference LoRA).

style.label: Style picture
style.description: Its look (colour, brushwork, light) is applied; its content is not copied.

timing_basis: one reviewed run on this server at default settings

name: Picture to 3D relief (MoGe-2)
description: Estimates the surfaces visible in ONE picture and returns them as a textured 3D mesh (GLB) plus a colour-coded depth map. It is a relief seen from the camera, not a closed object: the back and hidden sides do not exist.
